verdict.rationale: Honcho documents workspaces as top-level containers that isolate different applications or environments. Peers model users, agents and other entities, and retrieval can be shaped with peer scoping. Named-scope API keys bind access to one scope for recall and ingestion, which gives a documented enforcement mechanism against cross-tenant leakage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that per-user/per-agent peer data is guaranteed isolated from other peers' retrieval, detail on how scoped keys enforce boundaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation.
